title: Fix TypeScript errors introduced by tasks 0725/0745: BevelFilter mapping, FlashFilter re-export ambiguity, ColorPanel FillTypeId, PlayerWindow onTrace, unused vars
description:
Five TypeScript errors surfaced by `npx tsc --noEmit` that need fixing:

**packages/core** (2 errors):

1. **`flash8-import.ts:379` — BevelFilter `inner` field doesn't exist**
   `flash8-import.ts` maps `Fla8FilterBevel` to `BevelFilter` using `inner: f.inner` but `BevelFilter` uses `bevelType: "inner" | "outer" | "full"` (not a boolean `inner`). The mapping must convert the binary `inner` boolean + `onTop` boolean into the right `bevelType` string (`"inner"` if `f.inner`, `"full"` if `f.onTop`, else `"outer"`). Also missing `quality: passesToQuality(f.passes)` and `distance: f.distance` fields.

2. **`core/src/index.ts:5` + `tween/types.ts:3` — FlashFilter double-export ambiguity**
   `engine/index.ts` exports `FlashFilter` from `./filters.js`; `tween/types.ts` also re-exports `FlashFilter` from `../engine/types.js`. Both wind up at the root `core/index.ts` via `export * from "./engine/index.js"` and `export * from "./tween/index.js"`. Fix: remove `export type { ColorEffect, FlashFilter }` from `tween/types.ts` — it is already available from the engine barrel.

**packages/authoring-ui** (3 errors):

3. **`ColorPanel.tsx:494` — `"bitmap"` not assignable to `FillTypeId`**
   Task 0745 added `BitmapFill` to the `Fill` union but `ColorPanel`'s local `FillTypeId` type is still `"none" | "solid" | "linear-gradient" | "radial-gradient"`. Add `"bitmap"` to `FillTypeId` and add a no-op `case "bitmap"` branch to `fillToTypeId`.

4. **`Shell.tsx:4300` — `onTrace` prop not in `PlayerWindowProps`**
   `Shell.tsx` passes `onTrace={handleTrace}` to `<PlayerWindow>` but the exported `PlayerWindowProps` interface (in `packages/player/src/PlayerWindow.tsx`) is missing `onTrace`. The internal component already wires it through to `<RufflePlayer>`. Fix: add `onTrace?: (line: string) => void` to the `PlayerWindowProps` interface.

5. **`editMultipleFrames.test.ts:188` / `EaseCurveDialog.tsx:81` — unused variable warnings treated as errors**
   TS6133 for `currentFrame` (test file) and `sampleCurve` (component). Remove or prefix with `_` to suppress.

Acceptance: `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` and `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/authoring-ui/tsconfig.json` both exit 0 with no errors.
